name: Name
no_benefits: No available benefits at this time.
are_you_sure_logout: Are you sure you want to log out of your account?
greeting_tap_mic: Tap the mic and just talk.
memory_intro: Start talking or typing to Agak — I will automatically remember your questions, interests, and concerns here.
mic_blocked_body: Open Settings → Apps → AgakAI → Permissions → Microphone, then tap Try again.
mic_body: Agak uses the microphone only while you talk. Tap Allow, then speak. You can always type instead.
speak_done_hint: Speak your question… tap Done when finished.
live_captions_unavailable: Live captions unavailable — transcription will run when you tap Done
transcript_finalize_error: I couldn't finalize the live transcript. Please try speaking again.
transcript_empty_error: Didn't catch that — please try speaking again
voice_unavailable: Voice unavailable — you can read the answer on screen
login_invalid_credentials: Incorrect Senior ID or PIN. Please try again.
chat_error: I couldn't complete that request. Please try again.
onboarding_language_body: Choose the language for AgakAI buttons and instructions. Agak will respond to you in the language you speak or type.
onboarding_voice_body: Your language and text size are saved. Allow microphone access now if you want to use voice with Agak.
onboarding_spoken_intro: Hello. I am Agak. Your app language and text size are saved. If you want to speak with me, tap Enable microphone and allow access when Android asks. I only listen when you choose the microphone in the app. You can continue by typing if you prefer.
onboarding_mic_explainer: Your microphone is used only when you choose to speak. Android will ask you to allow microphone access.
onboarding_audio_unavailable: Audio is unavailable right now. You can still continue.
onboarding_mic_unavailable: Microphone is unavailable. You can still continue by typing.
onboarding_live_unavailable: Live captions are unavailable. Finish speaking to try transcription.
onboarding_transcript_error: We couldn't transcribe that recording. You can continue without voice.
onboarding_transcript_empty: No speech was recognized. Try again or continue without voice.
onboarding_mic_ready: Microphone access is ready. Android will remember this choice.
onboarding_mic_denied: Microphone access wasn't granted. You can still use AgakAI by typing.
onboarding_no_other_permissions: AgakAI doesn't need any other device permissions.
